text:
Jordan: quick morning check-in — finished the kernel patch to avoid double-scheduling on prefetch, ran microbench on a 2k seq workload.
Maria: nice, can you drop numbers?
Jordan: micro results: p50 18ms -> 12ms after change, p95 62ms -> 44ms. mem stable. toggled `KERNEL_PREFETCH=on` locally.
Kevin: huge, do we have a perf dashboard link?
Jordan: https://dash.redwood/internal/bench/1795 — watch the 'kv-hot' line. note the aliasing spike at ~02:14.
Sara: blocker: I hit an OOM in canary when prefetch concurrency hit 64. Need advice on knob limits.
Jordan: can you paste the pod logs? also which model and batch size?
Sara: model: llama-2-7b q4, batch_size 8. log snippet:
```
OOMKilled: runtime: out of memory allocating kv cache
alloc size=1.2G
```
Maria: try reducing prefetch concurrency to 32 and enable `KV_CACHE_PRUNE_THRESHOLD=0.6` for the canary.
Kevin: also make sure the kernel binary has the new memalign patch (PR #5123) — I left a comment.
Sara: pinging CI now, lowering concurrency. will update in a sec :pray:
devops-bot: deploy-canary to cluster-us-west started by Sara at 1795554700
Sara: canary rolled with concurrency=32 and prune=0.6 — initial smoke looks green. p50 slightly higher but within SLO.
Jordan: follow-up todo: add a guard to fallback prefetch when memory pressure > 80% (file an issue).
Maria: assigned to @Jordan? or should I pick up the issue for the orchestration side?
Jordan: I'll own the kernel change, Maria can do the orchestration flag and rollout policy.
Kevin: quick CR ping: Jordan's PR needs one more reviewer, @Maria can you take a look? small inline nits only.
Maria: will review today, aim to merge before EOD.
Sara: no more blockers from me, will monitor the canary for 2 hours and report regressions.
Jordan: thanks team. if anyone sees kv-evict spikes, post here with timestamps.
Kevin: noted. I'll add a perf check to the nightly job to compare p95 for 2k seq.
devops-bot: nightly-bench job queued (id: nb-1795) — results tomorrow.
